gap: On about, scrapbook and contact the copy sits on flat, square-cornered cream UI panels that fill 50-70% of the screen with no tape, tilt, paper edge or shadow, so half the phone reads as a web card stack rather than notes taped to the golden-hour wall.
notes: Hello/taped are well composed (name, memory cluster, handwriting and chips each have a zone; photos recognisable), but the top vignette crushes the 'MEMORIES 2024-2026' mono label to near-illegible and swallows a second top-right label; hello also has a dead band between the cluster and the handwriting. About: the two text cards stack with an empty shadowed wall band above them; the portrait and the coursework/GPA notes sit in window shadow, against 'text sits in light'. Scrapbook: the card pushes both photos to the bottom 25%; the team photo is still readable. Contact: hard dark band across the top 40%. Spex is the strongest screen. Body text is 16px+ everywhere, nothing clipped, no horizontal scroll, no console errors.
